name: Microgrid bus-voltage deviation monitor
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Reports the difference between the monitored bus voltage and its assigned reference.
description: Reports the difference between the monitored bus voltage and its assigned reference. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Bus voltage and reference” at the input and “Voltage deviation information” at the output. Measurement location matters.
